title: Protection Premium Held Back From a Northbeam Renew Trade-In Credit
content:
The premium standing on the profile's protection cover is held back from the credit, because the cover on the devices ends with the devices. The premium is the premium outstanding on a plan the profile holds under Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans, read from that plan's own record.

**Where the profile holds a protection plan standing active and premium stands outstanding on it**
the whole premium outstanding is held back from the Northbeam Renew Trade-In credit.

**Where the profile holds a protection plan standing in claim hold and premium stands outstanding on it**
half the premium outstanding is held back, rounded to the cent, and the rest is carried until the claim is decided.

**Where the profile holds no protection plan with premium outstanding**
nothing is held back on that account.

**Reading the branches.** Each of the first two is a pair: the state the plan stands in, and premium standing outstanding on it above nothing. A plan standing active with nothing outstanding falls into the third branch, and so does a plan standing in any state other than active or claim hold.

**Hypothetical illustrations.** A profile holding a plan standing active with 431.00 USD of premium outstanding has 431.00 USD held back. The same premium on a plan standing in claim hold has 215.50 USD held back, the other half being carried until the claim is decided. A premium outstanding of 431.05 USD on a plan standing in claim hold gives a holdback of 215.53 USD once the half is rounded to the cent.
